% Pattern: number/format. A class that sets the section format to letters
% inside its \appendix command sets it when \appendix runs, not in the
% preamble. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 1.1
% want lemma-2 statement/lemma 2.1
% want lemma-3 statement/lemma A.1
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{lemma}{Lemma}[section]
\makeatletter
\renewcommand\appendix{\par
  \setcounter{section}{0}\renewcommand\thesection{\Alph{section}}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{lemma} Every point is closed. \end{lemma}
\section{Two}
\begin{lemma} Every line is closed. \end{lemma}
\appendix
\section{Three}
\begin{lemma} Every plane is closed. \end{lemma}
\end{document}
